name: pgvector
what_it_is: An open-source extension providing vector similarity search for Postgres, in its own words. Embeddings live in an ordinary column, so a similarity search is a query against the same database, in the same transaction, as the rows it joins to.
why_it_matters: It answers the question most retrieval projects should ask first — whether a separate system is needed at all. Keeping vectors beside the records they describe removes a service to run, a copy to keep in sync and a consistency problem to reason about. Where it gives out is scale and index tuning, and that limit arrives later than teams expect.
suitable_for: Retrieval that must join to relational data in one query
Avoiding a second datastore until the limit is demonstrated
not_suitable_for: Corpora large enough to need distributed indexing
Workloads needing index types or filtering the extension does not implement
Teams with no Postgres in the stack, where it brings a database along with it
